positions.title: Software Engineering (SWE) Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to the feature migration from the Dart Virtual Machine (VM) legacy debugging tool 'Observatory' to the newer suite of debugging and performance 'DevTools', which has dedicated UX/UI support.
• Focused on porting the object browsing functionality to allow VM engineers to easily access and inspect elements of the running program structure; such as class objects, function objects, and script objects.
• Developed a VM object inspector tool for Dart & Flutter DevTools, which can be used to inspect the 6 main Dart VM object types, with support for future expansions to inspect other object types.
• Leverage the Dart VM Service protocol to request, process, and display data related to the specific object types, such as memory size, retaining paths, inbound references, field owner, function kinds, etc. 
• Engaged in regular communications with my host, co-host, and members from the Dart/Flutter VM and DevTools teams to discuss best practices for implementation details, code health, scalability, and testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Dart · Flutter · User Experience Design (UED) · Dart VM Service Protocol · Web Development

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
• Involved in different projects, conceptual studies, planning, and project management.
• Led the development of conceptual hydropower projects, assigned individual tasks to the team, and set milestones to present results in a timely manner.
• Collaborated with Pasadena's PWP to formulate strategies for a Power Delivery Master Plan report.
• Maintained regular communications with client representatives and provided feedback to team members.
